messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Inkline Labs showing a sharp usage drop starting 3/12. Our health dashboard: daily token calls down ~82% week-over-week and procurement chatter that they're evaluating ByteScale. Need quick triage before Friday's renewal check-in. @sam_renewals @tom_ae please.

sam_renewals: Got it. Can you paste the key metrics? seats, tokens/day, any auth errors?

maria_cs: quick snapshot from metrics ->
```
last 7d: tokens/day avg 560 (prev 3,200)
active seats: 3 (prev 14)
embeddings calls/day: 80 (prev 900)
no sustained 5xx spikes, a couple 401s on 3/13 tied to an API key rotation ticket: https://our-ops/ticket/INK-4421
```

jason_se: thanks — two immediate hypotheses: 1) procurement pulled keys while they evaluate alternatives; 2) they switched a part of traffic to a cheaper reranker/embedding provider. Do we have recent cost comparison in the CRM?

maria_cs: CRM note: procurement PM (Maya Patel) mentioned price sensitivity + ByteScale pilot. No technical blockers reported by their infra team.

tom_ae: I met ByteScale at a partner event — their pitch is cheaper quantized embeddings at scale. We should prepare a cost/latency delta and a short-run offer (e.g., 30-day dedicated trial or X% credit). Can we show predictable latency + support SLA as win?

priya_platform: Engineering idea: offer a guided cost runbook — enable quantized model + our batching + prefix cache and show projected monthly spend for their workload. I can prep a small config and run a 48h canary on one customer workspace to surface real numbers. Need Inkline ops sign-off.

ops-bot: :warning: Account alert — usage drop >= 70% for Inkline Labs. Flagged for renewal-risk queue. (id: alert-2026-03-17-INK)

maria_cs: Plan proposed: 1) quick 30-min sync with Maya + CTO (Fri 10am PT) to surface concerns; 2) Priya to run canary config with estimated cost sheet; 3) Tom to draft a limited-time economics offer (credits + SLA). Sam, can you own renewal playbook and escalate to renewals ops if they request competitive pricing?

sam_renewals: I will own renewals playbook. If they ask for a price match, we escalate to finance for a tailored committed plan. I'll also prep win/loss notes from ByteScale pilot.

maria_cs: Thanks all — I'll ping Maya to confirm Fri and attach the metric snapshot. Adding follow-up checklist in the thread. :spiral_calendar: :mag_right:

priya_platform: I'll start the canary config and share exact runbook + expected delta by EOD tomorrow.

tom_ae: I'll draft the economy offer and share pricing diff + SLAs for review.

maria_cs: nice — marking this high-priority. If anyone hears direct mention of a signed PO to ByteScale, shout here immediately. :loud_sound:
